column1: Mimicking

Our only conclusion is that we're getting there, America, because the American people have put their incredible spirit, determination, and resilience into action every single day. We’ve seen it in the way they’ve stepped up, followed the guidelines, and worked together to protect their families and communities. It’s a testament to the strength of this great nation, and I’m proud to say we’re making tremendous progress. Let’s keep pushing forward, because together, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

But as the President suggested, when we unveil the guidelines that the team has been working on, it's going to be something really special. Nobody does it better than us, believe me. These guidelines are strong, they're smart, and they're going to keep America safe. We've got the best people, the best minds—tremendous minds—working on this. And you're going to see results like never before. It's going to be fantastic, just fantastic. The American people deserve nothing less.

So--no, we were always going to get it. We never had a problem with it. And, you know, it’s really something. People are saying it’s incredible, the way we handled it. We’ve got the best people, the best systems, and we’re doing things nobody else could do. It’s all about strength, determination, and, frankly, common sense. We’re winning, and we’re going to keep winning. Believe me, it’s going to be tremendous.

All I'm saying is this: How do you close down the greatest economy in the history of the world and then expect it to just bounce back overnight? It doesn’t work that way. We built something incredible, something unmatched, and now we’re seeing the consequences of reckless decisions. But let me tell you, we’re going to come back stronger, smarter, and more resilient than ever. Because that’s what America does—we rise, we rebuild, and we win. Believe me.

When we think of more than 619,000 Americans having tested positive, more than 45,000 having lost their lives, it’s a tragedy of immense proportions. But we’re fighting back, and we’re fighting back hard. We’ve mobilized our greatest resources, our brightest minds, and our most advanced technology. Together, we’re making tremendous progress. The American spirit is resilient, and we will overcome this challenge. We will emerge stronger, more united, and more determined than ever before.

The next second time that I went with Dr. Birx in--to the President and said, "Mr. President, we need to take immediate action—these numbers are just too high, and we can’t afford to wait. The American people are counting on us to lead, and I know you understand the gravity of the situation. We’ve seen what’s happening around the world, and we’ve got to be smarter, stronger, and faster than anyone else. It’s all about protecting our great nation, and we’re going to do it together, because that’s what we do best."

And after that, I said, "Oh, make sure that's in the bill." It was amazing And after that, I said, "Oh, make sure that's in the bill." It was amazing. People couldn’t believe it—how quick, how effective, how strong it was. We got it done, just like I promised. And let me tell you, it’s going to make a huge difference, a tremendous difference, for so many Americans. They’re going to see results, and they’re going to love it. Believe me.

But the big thing, never quit, never give up; do something you love. When you But the big thing, never quit, never give up; do something you love. When you face challenges, and we all do, you push through because that's what winners do. Believe in yourself, work hard, and surround yourself with great people. America is the land of opportunity, and if you stay focused, you can achieve incredible things. Persistence, passion, and determination—that’s the formula for success.

If you're Democrat, you have automatic protection. That's years and years of people putting in the work, building the system, and making sure it’s all set up for you. But if you’re Republican, you’ve got to fight every step of the way. It’s not fair, but that’s the way it is. We’ve got to keep pushing, keep winning, and keep making America great again. The left doesn’t play fair, but we’ll never stop fighting for what’s right.

In the last three years, ICE has arrested over 5,000 wicked human traffickers. And I am proud to say that we’ve dismantled numerous trafficking networks, saving countless lives in the process. These criminals prey on the vulnerable, but under my administration, we’ve made it clear: there’s no place for them in this country. We’ve strengthened our borders, enhanced enforcement, and partnered with international allies to bring these predators to justice. America is safer because of these actions.

We've removed unnecessary restraints on our warfighters in Afghanistan. Those who risk their life and the greatest sacrifices for our nation deserve the utmost support and flexibility. We’re ensuring they have the tools, resources, and freedom to make the best decisions on the ground. This is about winning, and winning decisively. We’ve seen incredible progress, and I’m confident our brave men and women will continue to deliver results. America stands behind them, always. God bless our troops and God bless America.

We have a chance now to pass into law the immigration reforms that the American people have been asking for—reforms that will secure our borders, protect American workers, and ensure a fair and just system for everyone. It’s about putting America first, as we always do. These are commonsense measures, and they’re long overdue. We’re going to get it done, and we’re going to do it swiftly because that’s what the American people deserve. Let’s make it happen.

And I've been able to talk to many of those states. And I just remind them of the importance of staying strong, staying united, and continuing to follow the guidelines that have been proven to work. We’ve made tremendous progress, and I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished together. But we can’t let up now. We must keep pushing forward, keep innovating, and keep protecting the health and safety of every American. Together, we will prevail.

From the instant I took office, I moved rapidly to revive the U. S. economy--slashing burdensome regulations, cutting taxes for hardworking Americans, and unleashing the full potential of our great nation. We’ve seen record job growth, historic stock market highs, and a resurgence of American manufacturing. It’s been incredible, truly incredible. And we’re just getting started. Together, we’re building an economy that works for everyone—strong, prosperous, and unmatched anywhere in the world. Believe me, the best is yet to come.

You know, the truth is that we have coronavirus cases now in 46 American states. And let me tell you, we’re doing an incredible job handling this, really incredible. Our people are strong, our doctors are the best, and our response has been second to none. We’ve got the best minds working on it, day and night, and we’re making tremendous progress. But let’s stay vigilant, follow the guidelines, and keep America safe. Together, we’ll beat this.

I want to speak now directly to America's children, especially those who feel lost, alone, or uncertain about the future. I want you to know that you are not forgotten. This country is full of opportunities, and we are working tirelessly to ensure that you have the tools and support you need to succeed. Believe in yourselves, because we believe in you. Together, we will build a brighter, stronger America that will stand as a beacon of hope for the world. Stay strong, stay focused, and never give up on your dreams.

The last two lines are aerosols. What does it do in the air? We have the situation well under control. These aerosols, they disperse, and we’ve got the best experts studying it—top minds, really incredible people. We’re working closely with the CDC, FDA, and other agencies to ensure safety. It’s all about keeping the air clean and healthy for everyone. We’ve made tremendous progress, and I’m confident we’ll continue to protect the American people with the best measures possible.

These encouraging developments have put us in a very strong position to finalize guidelines for the safe reopening of our economy. We’re seeing tremendous progress across the board, and it’s all thanks to the hard work and dedication of the American people. Our businesses, schools, and communities are coming back stronger than ever. We’ve got the best plans, the best people, and the best country in the world. Together, we’ll continue to lead the way and make America greater than ever before.

Very importantly, we entered into historic cooperation agreements with the governments of Mexico, Honduras, El Salvador, and Guatemala to address the root causes of migration and enhance border security. These agreements are a big deal, believe me. We’re talking about strengthening economies, creating jobs, and improving safety for everyone involved. It’s about doing what’s right, and doing it smartly. Together, we’re making tremendous progress, and it’s all happening because of strong leadership and great partnerships.

That's page 1,689; page 1,762. Think of it: 1,762. And that's nowhere near the end of what we’ve accomplished. Tremendous progress, really tremendous. We’ve done more in a short time than anyone thought possible. And it’s not just numbers—it’s about the people, the lives we’ve changed, the futures we’ve secured. America is stronger, safer, and more prosperous because of it. Believe me, we’re just getting started. The best is yet to come. Big things, huge things. You’ll see.

But does anybody really believe the numbers of some of these countries that you've been hearing about? It’s really something, folks. We’ve seen it before—some places just throw numbers out there, and they don’t mean a thing. We’ve got the best data, the most transparent system, and our people are doing an incredible job. But when you look at others, you have to wonder. It’s all about accountability, and we’re leading the way, as always. Believe me.

And you'll see some data when Admiral Polowczyk gets up in just a few moments, and he’s going to show you the tremendous progress we’re making. It’s really incredible, the numbers we’re seeing, and it’s all thanks to the hard work of so many incredible people. We’re moving fast, we’re moving smart, and we’re getting it done. This is about results, and the results speak for themselves. You’re going to be very impressed.

To the citizens of our country, serving as your president has been the honor of my lifetime. Together, we’ve achieved so much—unprecedented economic growth, historic job creation, and a renewed sense of American pride. We’ve stood strong against threats, both foreign and domestic, and made sure our great nation remains safe and secure. None of this would’ve been possible without your support and belief in our shared vision. Let’s keep moving forward, making America stronger, prouder, and greater than ever before.

And, as you know, Europe was just designated as the hotspot right now, and we are closely monitoring the situation. We’ve implemented enhanced screening and travel restrictions to ensure the safety of the American people. It’s a tough decision, but it’s necessary. We’re working with our European allies, coordinating efforts, and sharing resources to combat this effectively. Together, we’ll get through this. It’s about protecting lives, and we’re doing it with strength and determination.

A small number of social media platforms are acquiring immense power over what we can see, hear, and share. This concentration of influence raises serious concerns about transparency, fairness, and the free flow of ideas. We must ensure that these platforms operate in the best interest of the American people, not just their bottom line. It's about preserving our freedoms and protecting the integrity of public discourse. Together, we can hold them accountable and restore trust in the digital age.

And whether it's Kate Steinle or so many others, they'd be around today if these laws were enforced. We need strong borders, the strongest borders, to protect our citizens. It's common sense, folks. Let's keep the bad people out and the good people in. We've made huge progress, tremendous progress, but there's more to do. Together, we'll make America safe again, the safest it's ever been. Believe me, it's going to happen. And it's going to happen fast.

But, for now, the best advice that we can give for people is to speak to their doctors, to their local health officials, and to stay informed. Listen to the experts, because they know what they’re talking about. We’re in a strong position to handle this, and we’ve got the best people working on it. Remember, it’s all about staying safe, staying smart, and following the guidelines. Together, we’ll get through this stronger than ever before. Thank you.

As long as you remain loyal, faithful, and true, then our enemies don't even stand a chance. They’ll see the strength of our unity and the power of our resolve. We’ve built something incredible, something no one thought was possible, and we’re just getting started. Together, we’ll protect what we’ve achieved and take it to even greater heights. Trust me, we’re going to win like never before—big league.

The NIH, CDC, and FDA are also currently validating several antibody tests that will allow us to better understand the spread of COVID-19 and identify those who have been infected. It’s a game-changer, folks. We’re talking about precision, accuracy, and speed—things we’ve never seen before. These tests are being developed by the best minds, and I’ve made sure they have the resources they need. Trust me, this is a big deal, and it’s going to make a tremendous difference in our fight against this virus.

Good afternoon everybody. My name is Bill Bryan and I lead the Science and Technology Directorate at the Department of Homeland Security. We’ve been working tirelessly, around the clock, to ensure the safety and security of our great nation. Our focus has been on developing cutting-edge solutions to combat emerging threats, and we’ve made tremendous progress. I want to thank our incredible team, whose dedication and expertise have been nothing short of extraordinary. Together, we are building a safer, stronger future for all Americans.

No, they say worse; they say negative. They say negative. They're going to make the picture look grim, but I know better. We’ve faced challenges before, and we’ve always come out on top. The numbers don’t tell the full story—they never do. We’re stronger, smarter, and more resilient than the headlines suggest. America is rising, and no amount of negativity can change that. Believe me, we’re going to make it bigger and better than ever.

Likewise, we are restoring our nation's manufacturing might, even though predictions were, as you all know, very grim just a few years ago. We’re bringing jobs back—good-paying jobs, the kind of jobs that support families and communities. It’s happening in steel, in auto, in technology, and across so many sectors. Companies are reinvesting in America because they see the potential, the opportunity, and the leadership. We’re not just rebuilding; we’re reimagining what’s possible for this great country.

At the same time, we know that mortality and the fatalities that we're facing across the country are deeply tragic. We’re doing everything we can to reduce these numbers, and I want to thank our incredible healthcare professionals who are working tirelessly, day and night, to save lives. It’s a tough situation, but we’re making progress. We’ve got the best people, the best resources, and we’re going to get through this together. America is strong, and we will prevail.

So when I got $700 billion, and then $716 billion -- and this year, it's So when I got $700 billion, and then $716 billion -- and this year, it's even bigger, folks, believe me. We’re talking about tremendous investments, the biggest ever, into our economy, into our military, into our future. And everybody’s saying it, they’re saying, “Wow, what a job he’s doing.” And it’s true. We’re making America stronger, safer, and richer than ever before. Nobody does it like us.

Today, I am proudly announcing six brand-new initiatives to propel this new era of American innovation and leadership. These initiatives will focus on revitalizing our infrastructure, boosting domestic manufacturing, and ensuring energy independence. We’re talking about creating millions of jobs, strengthening our economy, and putting America first like never before. It’s going to be huge, folks. Together, we’ll build a future that’s stronger, safer, and more prosperous for every American. Believe me, this is just the beginning.

And what you're seeing now with this order is that we're going to be able to get our great American workers back on the job, and safely. Nobody wants that more than me, believe me. It’s going to be fantastic—really, really fantastic. We’re protecting lives, and we’re saving jobs. That’s what this is all about. And let me tell you, nobody does it better than us. We’re going to make America stronger than ever before.

The ongoing tragedy in Syria is heartbreaking. Our shared goals must be the de-escalation of violence, the protection of innocent civilians, and the pursuit of a peaceful resolution. We’ve been working tirelessly with our allies, and we’ve made progress, but there’s still so much to do. The Syrian people deserve stability, security, and hope for a brighter future. Together, we can and must achieve these goals. It’s not just about policy—it’s about humanity. And we will not stop until peace is restored.

Together with millions of hardworking patriots across this land, we built the greatest political movement in history. People came together from all walks of life, from big cities to small towns, and they said, "Enough is enough." They stood up for their values, their families, and their futures. We fought for jobs, for safety, for fairness, and for the American Dream. And we won. America is stronger than ever, and we’re just getting started. Believe me.

It's been a horrible time to see such death and destruction, especially when you come to a place like this, where so much has been lost. But we’re rebuilding, and we’re doing it stronger than ever before. The resilience of the American people is truly incredible. We’ve faced challenges before, and we’ve always come out on top. This time will be no different. Together, we’ll restore, we’ll recover, and we’ll make America greater than ever. Believe me.

It was that same yearning for freedom that nearly 250 years ago gave birth to this great nation, the United States of America. We fought hard, we fought tough, and we won—big league. Nobody thought it was possible, but we did it. And let me tell you, we're going to keep winning. Because that's what we do. America first, always. We have the best people, the best spirit, and nobody—nobody—can take that away from us. Believe me.

Through four long years, you have honed your skills, trained your mind and body, overcome adversity, and emerged stronger than ever. You’ve shown incredible resilience, determination, and an unwavering commitment to achieving greatness. This journey hasn’t been easy, but it’s been worth it. Together, we’ve built something truly special, something that will stand the test of time. Now, let’s take this momentum and keep moving forward, because the best is yet to come.

I was in Vietnam, and the Prime Minister and the President of Vietnam were there. We had a tremendous meeting, absolutely tremendous. We discussed trade, security, and how to strengthen our relationship even further. Vietnam is a great country, with great people, and we’re working on some really big deals that will benefit both of our nations. They’ve been terrific partners, and I told them, "We’re going to do things together that nobody thought possible." It’s going to be huge.

So I can only tell you what I know and what my recommendations were. But, ultimately, the decisions are made by the people in charge—the experts and leaders who have the best information. I’ve always believed in trusting the process, and I think we’ve done a tremendous job under very difficult circumstances. The data speaks for itself, and the results are clear. We’ve made incredible progress, and I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished together. It’s all about moving forward with strength and confidence.

Jobs and companies are coming back to our country like never before. The power of American innovation and determination is truly unstoppable. We’re seeing factories reopen, businesses thrive, and wages rise—proof that our policies are working. It’s a great time to be an American worker, with opportunities growing and confidence soaring. Together, we’re rebuilding our nation stronger than ever, securing a brighter future for our families and communities. The best is yet to come!

And I don't think--I don't know who gave the orders to stop in Vietnam. But And I don’t think—I don’t know who gave the orders to stop in Vietnam. But I can tell you this: it was a tremendous mistake, a disaster, really. We had the power, we had the momentum, and we walked away. It’s like a fight where you’re winning, and then you just quit. Nobody respects that. We should’ve finished the job, strong, with victory. That’s how you earn respect.

Interestingly, we were just talking, I was talking to Doug, and the numbers they're doing with the economy are just tremendous, really tremendous. You look at the job growth, the way businesses are booming, it’s historic, folks. Historic. We’ve never seen anything like it. And Doug, he’s a smart guy, he knows what he’s talking about. We’re making deals, we’re winning, and America is stronger than ever. People are saying it’s the best it’s been in decades, and they’re right. Believe me.

But let me just tell you--wait. And what they're doing, because they think it is But let me just tell you--wait. And what they're doing, because they think it is, frankly, very dangerous and very unfair to the American people. We’ve got to stop it. It’s not acceptable, and we’re going to take action—big action. I’ve been saying it for a long time, and now we’re finally doing something about it. Believe me, it’s going to be huge.

I want to thank Deborah Birx, and I want to ask her maybe to come to the stage and share a few words. Deborah has been a tremendous asset to our team, absolutely tremendous. Her dedication, her expertise, and her tireless efforts have been instrumental in our fight against this virus. She’s been working around the clock, and I think everyone here can agree—Deborah Birx is a true leader, a true patriot. Let’s give her a big round of applause.

Last year, 70,000 Americans were killed, at least -- I think the number is ridiculously low, by the way -- by drug overdoses. It's a crisis, folks, and we need to take action. We’re going to strengthen our borders to stop the flow of these deadly substances. We’re also increasing funding for treatment programs and working with law enforcement to crack down on the dealers. This is a national emergency, and we’re going to handle it, believe me.

A safe and phased reopening of our economy--it's very exciting, but it does not mean that we stop being vigilant. We must continue to protect our citizens, especially the most vulnerable among us. It's about balancing progress with caution—smart moves, strong moves. We've come so far, and I’m proud of the resilience shown by the American people. Let’s keep the momentum going, follow the guidelines, and ensure we emerge stronger than ever. Together, we’ll achieve greatness.

Evelyn, Elizabeth, Freddy, and Robert: Tonight, everyone in this chamber is praying for you. Everyone in this great nation is standing with you. You represent the strength and resilience of the American spirit. We’ve faced challenges before, and we’ve always come out stronger. With faith, determination, and unity, we will overcome anything. Together, we’ll make sure your future is brighter than ever. God bless you, and God bless the United States of America.

I have to say that, very excitingly, we're going to have somebody up; Bill will be with us in just a moment. He’s a fantastic person, a real winner, and he’s done an incredible job. We’re going to hear from him directly—no filters, no spin, just the straight facts. You’re going to love it. This is big, this is important, and together, we’re going to make tremendous progress. Stay tuned—it’s going to be great.

She saw it very early on, and we have -- I don't know if we have ever seen anything like it before. It was incredible, really incredible. She had a vision, a tremendous vision, and she acted on it quickly, decisively. That’s what leadership is all about. We’re talking about someone who saw the big picture, who understood the stakes, and who made the right calls at the right time. It’s a rare thing, but when you see it, you know it. And she did it. She really did it.

With every action, my administration is restoring the rule of law and reasserting the culture of our great nation. We’re enforcing policies that protect our borders, uphold American values, and ensure fairness for all. The progress we’ve made is incredible, truly historic. People are seeing results, and they’re saying, “Wow, this is what leadership looks like.” Together, we’re making America stronger, safer, and more prosperous than ever before. And believe me, the best is yet to come.

But a tremendous thing was done over the last number of months, but really, if you think about it, over the last few years—we’ve made incredible progress. People said it couldn’t be done, but we did it. We’ve rebuilt our economy, we’ve protected our borders, and we’ve put America first. It’s a beautiful thing, really. And now, we’re moving forward, stronger than ever before. The best is yet to come, believe me. We’re just getting started.

Well, I don't know that I had exposure, but I don't have any of the symptoms, and that’s a good thing. We’ve been very cautious, very careful, and I think that’s what’s kept us safe. It’s all about being smart, following the rules, and using common sense. We’ve got the best doctors, the best scientists, and they’re doing incredible work. Stay positive, stay vigilant, and we’ll get through this together.

The Iranian government masks a corrupt dictatorship behind the false guise of a democracy. It rigs elections, silences dissent, and suppresses the voices of its own people while pretending to uphold freedom. The leaders enrich themselves at the expense of their citizens, ignoring the suffering of millions. It’s a disgrace—a regime that thrives on deception and oppression. The world sees through their lies, and the Iranian people deserve better, far better.

I'm the one that find them. I'm the one that settled it. Over a billion dollars—tremendous amount. And, you know, it’s not just about the money. It’s about doing what’s right, making sure we’re the best, the strongest, and the most respected. That’s what I do. I get things done, and I do it fast. Better than anyone else, believe me. We’ve had incredible success, and we’re just getting started. Big things ahead.

The core rights and values America defends today were inscribed in America's founding documents. Our forefathers envisioned a nation of liberty, justice, and opportunity for all—principles that continue to guide us. We’ve faced challenges, but we’ve always risen stronger, just like we’re doing now. America’s spirit is unmatched, and together, we’ll ensure these freedoms endure for generations to come. Our unity, resilience, and determination are what make this country the greatest on Earth. God bless America!

We'll continue our historic regulatory reduction campaign. We've--as you know, in three and a half years, we've cut more regulations than any administration in history. It's been incredible, really tremendous. Businesses are thriving, jobs are booming, and the economy is stronger than ever. We're putting America first, and the results speak for themselves. People are seeing it, they're feeling it, and they're loving it. Together, we're making America great again, like never before.

Iain has always dreamed of going to space. He was the first in his class to study astrophysics, and he’s been working tirelessly ever since to make that dream a reality. NASA took notice of his dedication and innovation, and now, he’s on the shortlist for the next mission to the International Space Station. It’s incredible, truly incredible. With his talent and determination, Iain is going to do amazing things—things people said couldn’t be done. America needs more like him.

As just one example, I recently met the CEO of a terrific American company, Micron Technology, and let me tell you, they’re doing incredible work—tremendous work—right here in the United States. They’re creating jobs, investing in innovation, and leading the way in semiconductor manufacturing. It’s companies like Micron that are making America stronger, more competitive, and more resilient. We’re going to keep supporting them, because when they win, America wins. Believe me, it’s a beautiful thing.

But this is an unprecedented time. But I have to tell you: When you look at the incredible resilience of the American people, it’s truly remarkable. We’ve faced challenges before, and we’ve always come out stronger. This time will be no different. We’ve got the best minds working on solutions, the best tools at our disposal, and the best nation on Earth standing together. Remember, we’re in this fight as one team, one people, and we will prevail. Believe me.

But I took this action early. And so the story in the New York Times But I took this action early. And so the story in the New York Times was wrong—totally wrong. They didn’t get the facts straight, as usual. I acted decisively, swiftly, and with the best interests of the American people in mind. The results speak for themselves. We’ve achieved tremendous success, and the numbers don’t lie. Let’s keep winning, folks. It’s a great story, a winning story.

Thank you very much. So I asked Bill a question that probably some of you were thinking about as well. It’s about the economy, jobs, and how we’re going to keep America strong. You know, we’ve done tremendous things—record numbers, historic numbers. But we’re not stopping there. We’re going to keep pushing, keep winning, because that’s what we do. America first, always. And we’re going to make sure every single American benefits from this incredible success. Thank you.

We see it in sons and daughters who cheer on moms and dads as they step up and serve their communities with incredible dedication. We see it in neighbors helping neighbors, businesses supporting families, and volunteers giving their time to make a difference. This spirit of unity and resilience is what makes America great. Together, we’re tackling challenges, achieving milestones, and proving that when we work as one, there’s nothing we can’t accomplish. God bless America!

So we called some people, wished them a very happy Labor Day, and they told us how much they appreciated the call. It’s a big deal for them, you know, to hear directly from us. We’re making sure everyone feels valued, because that’s what it’s all about—respecting hard work, American workers, and celebrating their contributions. Labor Day is a time to recognize the backbone of this country, the people who make it great. And we’re doing just that.

In Philadelphia, observers have been kept far away -- very far away -- so far in fact, that they can’t even see what’s happening inside. It’s a tremendous safety measure, one of the best, frankly. We’ve got to protect everyone involved, and that’s exactly what they’re doing. It’s smart, it’s effective, and it’s the way it should be. Common sense, really. Philadelphia is handling this very well, very professionally. Big progress.

In just over 2 years since the election, we have launched an unprecedented economic boom--a boom that has lifted millions of Americans out of poverty and created jobs at a record pace. Our policies have unleashed the power of American innovation, and we’re seeing results like never before. Businesses are thriving, wages are rising, and confidence is soaring. It’s a testament to the strength and resilience of the American people. Together, we’re building a future of prosperity and opportunity for all.

The American people will be encouraged to know that, as we stand here today, 24 million jobs have been added since the start of this administration. That’s a tremendous number—historic, really. Our economy is booming like never before, and we’re just getting started. Businesses are thriving, wages are rising, and confidence is through the roof. Together, we’re making America stronger, safer, and prouder than ever. The best is yet to come—believe me.

As part of our efforts, we're leveraging the unique capabilities of S&T's National Biodefense Analysis and Countermeasures Center to develop innovative solutions that will protect our nation from future biological threats. This facility is not just a laboratory—it's a cornerstone of our national security. We’re working tirelessly to stay ahead of the curve, ensuring that we’re prepared for anything. With the expertise of our scientists and the dedication of our teams, we’re making incredible strides. Together, we’re safeguarding America.

When our nation was hit with the terrible pandemic, we produced not one, but two remarkable vaccines in record time. It’s something nobody thought was possible, but we did it.
